nodes.label: Near-Market-Weight Flock Frame (Gas, 2022-03-14 22:24:07)
nodes.description: Bright colour overhead still labelled '1080P-IPC-Gas' and '2022-03-14 22:24:07'. Large, near-market-weight broilers cover almost the entire floor; only narrow strips of bare litter remain. Birds are packed shoulder to shoulder in tight fans radiating from each of the five pan feeders, and the feed pipe is partly hidden by birds standing beneath it.

nodes.label: Gas Camera Channel Label
nodes.description: The burned-in camera identifier '1080P-IPC-Gas', the second observed channel/condition name in the dataset alongside the Siren channel. Its presence shows the frame set spans at least two named environmental conditions captured by the same overhead rig.

nodes.label: Severe Occlusion at High Stocking Density
nodes.description: At late growth stage the birds tile the floor almost completely, so silhouettes merge into a continuous white mass with no separating background between neighbours.
nodes.rationale: This is why a detector trained only on early sparse frames will collapse on late frames: bounding-box detection assumes separable instances, an assumption that fails once the floor coverage approaches saturation. It argues for density/segmentation-style estimation or for stratifying training data across growth stages instead of sampling frames uniformly in time.
